notes.title: Legendary Deck Design Deep-Dive
notes.content:
Howdy Talisman fans!

Soon we’ll be launching some exciting new [i]Legendary Decks[/i] for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i], but before we do we wanted to sit down and talk through the process of creating both the four original [i]Legendary Decks[/i], and the four new ones we’ll be launching soon. You can find out more about these new ones in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/247000/view/3102417179775501602]original announcement post[/url]!

If you’ve never encountered any of our [i]Talisman: Digital Edition Legendary Decks[/i], they’re rebalanced and remixed versions of the adventure decks that come with each [i]Talisman[/i] expansion - especially designed to offer more challenge for the seasoned player.

We had a lot to consider when making these new decks, such as:
[list]
[*] How can we improve the Talisman: Digital Edition experience for more hardcore players?
[*] How can we best accomplish that by rebalancing each expansion?
[*] What would players expect to see in a Legendary Deck?
[*] And how do we do all of this in a way that keeps the core Talisman experience intact?
[/list]
We’re going to go through each of these to explain how we crafted these Legendary Decks that you’ll soon be able to play with! We’ll also use some specific examples from cards to show how we changed the way they function, and better demonstrate our design choices.

[h2]Improving the game for hardcore players[/h2]

Back before we made the [i]Legendary Decks[/i], we were brainstorming the different kinds of content we could possibly make for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i]. In order to narrow down what we could create, we decided to look at the different kinds of players who enjoy Talisman and what they get out of the game as they play it. It’s much easier to design something once you know who you’re designing it for!

One of the demographics we encountered was a group of players who specifically enjoy the challenge that comes from playing Talisman - the more difficult their adventure, the more they felt they’d accomplished by overcoming those obstacles that appeared during the game. We wanted to offer something that would give that group of players more flexibility to customise the challenge they faced as they play. We already knew that more experienced players tend to find the later parts of a Talisman game can become tedious once you’ve outclasses all the enemies and nothing can pose a threat to you.

The most obvious way to increase the challenge was to up the strength and craft of a number of enemies, in order to keep that danger around for longer! This helps mitigate the issue of longer games becoming boring, and also makes the earlier rounds much more deadly - a thrill we knew hardcore players would appreciate. Below are two examples of how we did this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/615a863d723f223c58a95b130944b7fe38682799.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/ca42485363cad36987ae3e8b0144cd412c469df2.png[/img]

As another example, for a number of cards we removed the fact that they were discarded at the end of turn. This might seem like a small change but it drastically changes how players make decisions as they play. For example, these three fine fellows no longer go off to the discard pile after you encounter them for the first time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/98921c58880374cac07e7a931b97e86b55832e06.png[/img]

Having the threat of landing on these cards adds a different feel to the game, and generally makes surviving in Talisman a harder job than it already was!

[h2]Rebalancing each expansion[/h2]

When we came to creating the [i]Legendary Decks[/i] for each expansion, it wasn’t simply a case of [i]‘make the numbers bigger and then it’ll be harder’[/i]. We wanted to update each expansion while still maintaining some form of balance to the game. 

On the surface, due to the random nature of Talisman, it can be argued that it’s already an unbalanced game to begin with. However, once you dig deeper into the way each deck is balanced and the different possibilities for cards you can draw, there is an underlying balance to how the game is built. Even if someone gets lucky, the other players also should have an equal chance of being just as lucky (if not luckier!)

Recognising this balance is something that more seasoned players would be able to notice - as that was our primary target audience for this content, we knew we needed to make sure we didn’t cause any balance issues. As they would most definitely get noticed!

So while we wanted to make each expansion more challenging and increase the risk each player would face when drawing a card, we didn’t want to remove that feeling of each player having equal chances to be as lucky (or unlucky) as each other. We also had a chance to make the game scale a bit better compared to the original expansions - with stronger creatures, you don’t have to hunt down multiple creatures to trade in for upgrading your abilities.

Another one of the ways we rebalanced cards for the [i]Legendary Decks[/i] is by changing the way they work in the game. Making sure that everyone is on a level playing field is important to ensure that the enhanced challenge stays roughly the same for everyone. If we take the [b]Arnkell[/b] card as an example:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/9e1f5f9bb0971e1970e9784a8eb8130a318a9f9b.png[/img]

Spot the difference? The original specifically says [b]moving normally[/b] while the new Legendary version says [b]rolling the die for movement[/b]. While on the surface this might not seem like a big change, it’s actually quite the nerf! ‘Moving normally’ covers standard movement and covers movement behaviour within the inner region (where you move 1 space at a time instead of rolling the dice to move). This adjustment makes it unusable in the inner region because you don't roll the die to move there - and stops players skipping to the crown!

So while it’s still very useful during the game, players can’t skip straight to the end of the game while avoiding any challenge.

[h2]Managing player expectations[/h2]

When we say [i]“We’re making Talisman harder for you”[/i], what do you expect that to actually mean? This is something that we asked ourselves before, during and after the design process. Firstly, we looked at the different expansions that people already consider ‘challenging’ such as [i]The Dragon[/i] or [i]The Firelands[/i] to see what people actually enjoyed or found challenging about them.

After talking to players and researching feedback, our main takeaway was that certain expansions don’t necessarily increase the ‘challenge’ overall, but instead make different stages of the game more difficult. For example, players often find that [i]The Dragon[/i] expansion makes surviving in the early game more of a challenge than normal. Expansions like [i]The Fireland[/i] increase difficulty from start to finish, and [i]The Cataclysm[/i] increases the challenge by forcing you to be more aware of where you’re planning on moving in the future.

We also found a common consensus with our own experience of playing lots of Talisman - that even if an expansion is difficult, the more expansions you add the less of an effect is has on the game. By adding more cards into the pool of possibilities, you reduce the chances that players will encounter them. (So playing with just the base game and [i]The Firelands[/i] expansion will be much more challenging that playing with The Firelands and 8 other expansions, for example!)

So in order to make sure we matched player expectations, we made sure that each [i]Legendary Deck[/i] features a range of difficult enemies at all stages of the game. If we’d simply loaded up each deck with super challenging monsters, it’d make the early game too difficult. We also put a unique ‘foil’ finish on each [i]Legendary Deck[/i] card, to help better visualise to players when they were battling a tougher enemy. We found that a small visual que like this helps players feel more accomplished for surviving an encounter, and also know where to avoid on the map at a glace.

[h2]Keeping the core Talisman experience there[/h2]

We’ve already touched on this a bit, but keeping the core Talisman experience intact was something that we didn’t want to lose sight of while creating these new decks. As seasoned board gamers ourselves, we’ve played enough games to know that each one has an ‘experience’ it’s trying to create. From something as simple as [i]Snakes and Ladders[/i] giving you the experience of scrabbling to the top of the board to more complex experiences like [i]Hostage Negotiator[/i], which recreates the feeling of a very tense stand-off with a kidnapper, even though you're just rolling dice and playing cards.

In [i]The City[/i] expansion, we know that a lot of players use the [b]Assassin[/b] to kill other players, as they can pay up to 3 gold and take a life from someone. Being able to take 3 lives from someone is mighty strong, so you can quite often just straight up kill people with it.

In the Legendary version of [i]The City[/i], we adjusted it so that the ability was more expensive and reduced the maximum life you could take. Have a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/b8ce5b2cd4b415297a41c272564fe7693798e8e3.png[/img]

We didn’t want to remove the [b]Assassin[/b] entirely, as we know a lot of players do enjoy using them as a way to eliminate other players - we just wanted to adjust how players were able to use them. We also made it so that the card is no longer discarded, so players can plan their next moves with more knowledge of where the [b]Assassin[/b] will be. As we knew these decks would be played by more experienced Talisman players, we didn’t have to worry as much about filling up the board with cards that need to be kept track of.

[h2]Final Thoughts[/h2]

This is the first time we’ve done this kind of design dive into something we’ve made, so we’re keen to hear your thoughts on it! Would you like more of this kind of thing? We won’t know unless you tell us, so pester us on [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url] all you like.

We’re super excited to see what the Talisman community thinks of these new Legendary Decks when they launch - don’t forget to give us your feedback over on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/247000/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] or our [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: New Legendary Decks coming soon to Talisman: Digital Edition
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

To help kick off 2022, we’re happy to announce that we’re bringing more Legendary Decks to [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i]! This time, we’re giving [i]The City[/i], [i]The Sacred Pool[/i], [i]The Blood Moon[/i] and [i]The Frostmarch[/i] expansions the Legendary treatment.

If you’ve never played with one of our Legendary Decks for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i] before, then we hope you’re up for the challenge. When you swap out the adventure deck for an expansion with the Legendary version, the monsters you face pose more of a challenge, and help is harder to come by. When we launched our first four Legendary Decks back in 2020, experienced Talisman players appreciated the extra difficulty it added to their game nights, and asked for more expansions to get the same treatment.

As with the first Legendary Decks we released, you’ll need to own the original expansion in order to play with these new decks. For example, in order to play with the [i]The Blood Moon Expansion Legendary Deck[/i], you’ll first need to own [i]The Blood Moon Expansion[/i] in order to swap it out!

These new decks will be available to purchase on Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Google Play and the App Store. Stay tuned to our website and all our social media channels to hear when they get released.

Each Legendary Deck has been carefully crafted and balanced by our designers to increase the challenge while keeping the original spirit of each expansion intact!

[h2]The City Expansion: Legendary Deck[/h2]

A fan favourite, [i]The City Expansion[/i] has been adjusted so that the streets are deadlier and the shops are more demanding of your gold.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690082/Talisman__The_City_Expansion_Legendary_Deck/

[h2]The Sacred Pool Expansion: Legendary Deck[/h2]

[i]The Sacred Pool Expansion[/i] focuses on your alignment, and so does the Legendary Deck version. If you’re not keeping an eye on your alignment, you could end up on the wrong side of some mighty monsters!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690081/Talisman__The_Sacred_Pool_Expansion_Legendary_Deck/

[h2]The Blood Moon Expansion: Legendary Deck[/h2]

The most well-known feature of [i]The Blood Moon Expansion[/i] is the Werewolf NPC, but now you’ve got some new things to fear! With stronger foes and deadlier things lurking in the night, we hope you’re not afraid of the dark...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690083/Talisman__The_Blood_Moon_Expansion_Legendary_Deck/

[h2]The Frostmarch Expansion: Legendary Deck[/h2]

Things are about to get much chillier this winter, as [i]The Frostmarch[/i] gets even more dangerous! Stay frosty as you try to survive adjusted foes and colder allies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690080/Talisman__The_Frostmarch_Expansion_Legendary_Deck

Don’t forget to stay tuned to our [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord[/url] for announcements, insights and more on these upcoming decks!

[b]P.S. We're aware that we still haven't updated the hidden achievements on Steam - in order to do so we need to roll out a patch on all platforms (which takes a long time for us to do, which is why we bundle a bunch of fixes into each patch rather than putting out lots of small ones). We'll be releasing a patch soon as part of rolling out these new decks, so you don't have to wait much longer! ːheartː[/b]

notes.title: Nomad Monthly Mailbag - August 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the very first [i]Nomad Games Monthly Mailbag[/i]! Every single month we’re going to be dedicating time to answering questions from you! Our lovely community have sent in some questions for us to answer, and it looks like it’s a bumper month due to it being the first ever mailbag. We’d like to think you all had these questions burning away for so long, and you’re finally letting them out. So let’s get to it!

If you’d like to be included in next month’s Monthly Mailbag, don’t forget to send an email over to questions@nomadgames.co.uk.

[b]From Christian Hinse[/b]

[i]“Hi Nomad!
Two questions for you:
- Were there situations during development (for Talisman or other tabletop adaptations), where you came to the conclusion that "no, a computer just cannot do that as well as a human player"?
- Will the Xbox version of Talisman ever get expansion-specific achievements?
Cheers!”[/i]

Our resident Talisman: Digital Edition expert Jethro Park chimed in with the following:

(For Talisman) Not that I can remember... There were times when we thought that, but were then proved wrong. An example of this is the AI's use of Random. When playing IRL, I think a lot of players (myself included) see Random as an opportunity to try toad another player, and if your target doesn't roll badly, they get a reward and taunt your attempts to thwart them. But because it hasn't got much to lose early on (and nor do the prospective enemy targets) the AI would frequently end up using Random on itself. Naturally, we and a lot of our players noticed this odd behaviour and assumed we knew better thinking there was a bug in there so we had a look into it. The AI's weighting for stats uses a sliding scale and for Strength (one of the rewards), that ends up at quite a high score when you don't have very much (which is why it particularly affected AI that started the game with Random, as 'spell-casters' typically have low strength). With the 1/3 chance of rolling one of the desired results, the AI was felt the negatives were outweighed by the positives and was satisfied with this level of risk to use it on itself. Turns out... it just knew better? (though I'm still a sceptic)

When it comes to expansion-specific achievements, it’s on our radar to do them - we just need to find the time!

[b]From Julio Teh[/b]

[i]“First of all, I want to thank everyone at Nomad Games for bringing great digital board games to us. I started off with Talisman: Digital Edition and I can wholeheartedly say that I am a fan of Nomad Games and everything they have released. I hope everyone at Nomad Games is safe, well, and awesome over there!

My question is as follows:
1. Are there any juicy updates for expansions in regards to Talisman: Digital Edition and Talisman: Origins?
2, Any future IP that Nomad Games is working on?

Thanks and all the best - from Malaysia!”[/i]

Thank you for the kind words! When it comes to your questions, the short answer to both is nothing we can share right now. Which isn’t a very fun answer! So for a longer answer, we can currently confirm that we’d be very happy to bring more content to Talisman: Digital Edition. We need to figure out exactly how and what that would look like first before we can share anything though. For Talisman: Origins, sadly we saw very little uptake on the expansions we released for the game, so making more expansions is a tougher ask for us from a financial point of view. We’d love to do it, but we need to balance that with making smart decisions!

And for question 2, there is an IP we’re currently working on and are in the design phase of. We’re still hashing out a lot of stuff so we can’t share anything right now, but don’t worry - we’re definitely working on something.

[b]From Wilf[/b]

[i]“Have you considered making some changes to gameplay that wouldn't work in the physical version? Or perhaps I should say some *other* changes, since, e.g., the Clockwork expansion's invention system would be horribly cumbersome in physical form. As one example, players currently get no trophies when defeating an enemy that's produced as the result of rolling on the Crags or Forest, etc. - in the digital version of the game, it would be fairly easy to make these 'constructed' enemies behave more like those on Adventure cards and appear as trophies when defeated. (Of course, changes like this ought to be hidden behind a checkbox in the game's options, for those folk who want to have things be identical to the physical game.)

Oh, another question while I'm here: when can we have some more Talisman: Origins DLC - it's a great game, and I want more.”[/i]

This is things we’ve absolutely considered! We’ve implemented house rules and expansions like you’ve mentioned that wouldn’t work physically. Seeing what other games are doing in the space of digital-only board games (like Magic: Arena and Hearthstone) shows us there’s definitely an appetite for that stuff. And our digital-exclusive expansions being so popular definitely helps too!

And we’ll stick to the same answer we gave above regarding Talisman: Origins DLC - sadly it’s a hard sell for us to invest in making any more right now. But one of the best things about us doing these community questions is that we get to hear directly from people what they want! You can’t just look at the data alone, right?

[b]From Ash[/b]

[i]“What's the order you go in when it comes to making the games? I've always wondered once you start tackling them.”[/i]
[olist]
[*] It’s probably easiest to break down the process into a number of different steps!
[*] We spend some time looking at and playing the physical board game
[*] We talk about how the design of the game will work, and come up with some concepts
[*] We let the art team go wild on designing how the game will actually look digitally
[*] We let the programmers and engineers start working on the actual game itself.
[*] We keep doing the coding until the game is ready to go!
[*] Hope that answers your question Ash!
[/olist]
[b]From Memox[/b]

[i][list]
[*] If you still have the time and passion for it, what are you guys playing these days? (Board games, gamebooks and/or videogames).
[*] Would you consider yourself more of a player or a film buff? Or maybe you have other interesting hobbies? Give me some examples of what should I watch/play today, please.
[*] Are you content regarding the current videogame industry? Or do you miss the times when it wasn't an industry, just some guys in a garage developing what they wanted? Personally, I feel that, for a lot of complex and rather mundane reasons I won't discuss for the sake of not boring you, the creativity and passion has subsided a little to give more space to safe bets circa the gameplay structure and whatnot, which in turn is heavily influenced by publishers and investors. Not just the customers, but even the developers are those who suffer the most about this, I think. I'm glad that's not exactly the case for Nomad Games, but I was wondering how you felt about it (of course without naming the software houses themselves) and if you had some anecdotal evidence about this matter or I'm just being overly nostalgic.
[*] Would you rather play a board game with House Rules which speeds up and improves the flow, or would you "endure" it for better or worse just for the sake to play it as intended, with the official ruleset?
[*] What are your favorite reads? What about your favorite gamebooks, if any? (i.e. Fighting Fantasy series).
[*] Are there some franchises that you wish you could adapt into a videogame but you didn't have the chance to do so (either for costs or other reasons)? Of course, feel free to ignore this question if it goes against your contract or anything like that.
[*] What's your favorite class in Talisman? (If you do play your own games )
[*] And most important of all, what's your favorite dish?
[/list]
Thank you very much for everything you did with some of my favorite pastimes ever. My Board Game Nights during the epidemic have been saved because of your faithful, atmospheric and great adaptation of Talisman. It has really helped our group during this year.[/i]

A bumper crop of questions! We’ve answered them below:

[list]
[*] Personally, I’ve been playing lots of Magic: Arena and Apex Legends - it’s much easier to boot up a game when I have some free time and play for a little while instead of sitting down in front of a 200-hour long RPG!
[*] Films bad, games good. Go play Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice if you haven’t aleady!
[*] A number of staff chimed in on this one… 
[*] Jethro: I think they're mostly right re: safe bets.. When that moves from being a safe bet on game (e.g. football manager 2014/15/16/17/etc.) to a safe bet on a developer then good things could still come of it I guess .. can't think of any though.
[*] Sam: The larger a company gets, the safer they (feel they) have to bet - but people are still out there in their garages making whatever they want.
[*] Ethan: I feel like big companies that take safe bets by making more games in an established franchise don't take away from indie developers' space in the industry. Maybe I'm thinking about it wrong, but isn't the reason those games are "safe bets" because a lot of people enjoy them?
[*] House rules imposed for the sake of speeding up a game aren't usually my thing because it seems like you want to spend less time playing it and maybe... actually just don't like the game and should play something different?
[*] I’ve recently finished The Terror and I know we have a lot of comic book fans here in the office - too many to name!
[*] Star Wars, Doctor Who, Marvel… all the classics!
[*] 2nd edition- Warrior of Chaos, Digital Edition - The Genie's always seemed pretty chill on his cloud, nice abilities too.
[*] One with high sides so your cereal doesn't spill
[/list]

[b]From Dana R[/b]

[i]“What is your key of success for making mad at nomad customer/gamer/fan become happy angel again? (I mean when we complain about glitches and things we don't like)”[/i]

From our QA manager, Michael: “I find that providing plenty of detail in a reply helps calms people down. As it shows that you're taking them seriously, even if their email was a bit ranty. Also it shows that you care about making sure their experience with a title is a good one. I've had a few (not many luckily) people email just to say "your game is filled with bugs fix it or I stop playing" along with some other things that I won't say here. But they calmed down once I replied with a list of questions regarding their bugs, which likely showed them that we're willing to fix said bugs if they help us in our search for it. I've also had people rant at us about things they think are bugs but are actually mechanics in the game or they've simply not switched on the right thing when creating a game. So I explain as best I can how those mechanics work and they've responded positively. Even if the person wasn't "angry" in their original reply, I find that people in general response positively to detailed replies because it shows we've taken the time to address their bug report/feedback/questions etc”

[b]From Kinkku Kankku[/b]

[i]“What do you guys consider to be the hardest single challenge currently added in the Challenge update? (No need to account completionist challenges)”[/i]

A tricky one, because most of them are designed with the intent that you would complete them through 'normal gameplay'. So the difficulty would probably come from the amount of times it's required, or scarcity of the particular target. There's one due in Sept that could be the hardest.. but currently my vote probably goes to getting the title Emissary of the Nether… which is a hidden challenge, so if you haven’t found it yet then keep looking!

[b]From DaKaT[/b]

[i]“Have you ever thought about reworking any DLC character? Maybe they didn't work as you anticipated? Or maybe the community didn't like them as much?”[/i]

This is actually something we’ve already done! Following feedback on the Witch Hunter character being too strong in PvP, we adjusted their stats to make them a bit more balanced.

[b]From primalandrew on Steam[/b]

[i]“My question is as follows: Would you ever consider adding a, "Talisman Timescape" esque, science-fiction heavy expansion?”[/i]

Considered it? Yes. Would we actually ever do it? Very doubtful!

[b]From Oliver[/b]

[i]“My name is Oliver and I've been looking into the old editions of Talisman recently. I am fascinated by the Timescape expansion of the 2nd edition, the idea of having the heroes of Talisman face the grim dark future and other dark timelines and their inhabitants sounds like a lot of fun to me.

So I've been wondering if there was any chance we could see the Timescape as a potential expansion for the Talisman Digital Edition in the future? I am looking forward to see new Talisman content and other board game conversions either way.”[/i]

Sadly not - we don’t have plans to bring back any older expansions, and Timescape is such an oddball that it doesn’t fit in with modern Talisman! We’re going to bring more things to you all we’re sure, but Timescape is going to be staying in the past.

[b]From Denizu[/b]

[i]“Hello, hope everyone at the Nomad team is doing well! I was wondering how it is to work in a smaller studio like yours. Does it feel like it comes with more freedom and a less orderly way of doing work? Or does it come with more strings attached to make ends meet and work on the tables? Do you constantly seek new projects, or are you happy with fleshing out the ones you are currently working on?

Thanks for all your hard work and may you all have a pleasant day.”[/i]

Oddly enough, it’s a mixture of both! We definitely have more freedom to make decisions and do what we like, but we always need to keep the bottom line in mind. We’re always on the look out for new projects, because it’s better to have too many and have to choose, than have too few and work on a project we don’t want to be working on!

[b]From Stephen Mullaney-Westwood[/b]

[i]“So... first question... Do you have your eyes on any other board game IPs to digitise?... or are you more focussed on adding to the current ones and improving those? Thanks for all your work Nomad... Talisman is very important to me :) & I own and enjoy other games of yours too.”[/i]

We sure do! We’re starting work on another board game IP digitisation as we speak. Only we can’t speak about it just yet. But we will at some point! We promise.

[b]From CHRUPPEK[/b]

[i]“After years of experience with different types of board games are you planning on creating your own board game?”[/i]

Not at the moment! It’s an idea that’s been tossed around jokingly a few times, but it’s a whole different world making physical board games over digital ones.

[b]From Kotołak[/b]

[i]“I have one pretty simple question. Will there be new DLC such a pack with cards or characters for Talisman Digital Edition? This is type of game with unlimited potential and this is what I love about your game. Even now Talisman seems to have a huge amount of content and thats why I will not send wild angry Orc to your company. Thanks for what you have done so far.”[/i]

We’re very confident that we’ll keep releasing content for Talisman: Digital Edition as long as people still want more content and are willing to pay for it! And we appreciate you not sending wild angry orcs at us, we don’t think that’s covered in the office insurance.

[b]From AP[/b]

[i]“So I have some friends that I'm trying to get into the board game. However, they keep saying it has a deep learning curve and that the length bores them. Are there any quick start guides or a way to show the game off without having them sit down for a full session? I really enjoy the game but often can't find fellow players.”[/i]

Sudden death mode helps a lot with that! Try setting a number of rounds for the game, then everyone scores based on what they achieved/collected. It's a good introduction to the game and helps speed it up a lot. It also helps to have new players start with as few expansions as possible or just no expansions, as they tend to add more complexity which can be overwhelming to newcomers. Hope that helps!

[b]From JT Holderman[/b]

[i]“Any more Mystic Vale expansions coming out for the digital game?!”[/i]

Right now we don’t have any plans for more Mystic Vale expansions sadly - if there is enough community demand for more then we’d be happy to take a look.

[b]From ⸸ KHORNE-FLAKES! ⸸[/b]

[i]“I’ve been wondering for a while if Talisman Horus Heresy would ever return to Steam or get a re-release. I would have loved to obtain a legal copy of the game and the DLCs. Have there been any talks or negotiations to get the licensing sorted with Games Workshop? This brings me to another question: Have you ever considered/would you consider giving a shot at creating a digital edition of the Relic boardgame? If yes, have there been any talks with Games Workshop about it?

I’ve been enjoying Carcassonne and Talisman Digital Edition a lot, especially since I can’t afford a real Talisman boardgame with all the expansions and your digital exclusive expansions are great, I really like the content they deliver.”[/i]

Sadly the licence expired on Talisman: Horus Heresy which meant that we didn’t have the rights to sell it. It’s a game we poured a lot of love into, so we were sad to see it go - but that’s the reality of working on licensed properties! We’ve talked to the folk at Games Workshop about it, and it’ll be brought back up and talked about in the future I’m sure. 

And Relic is something we’ve also considered and discussed, but due to it being so similar to Talisman already, we’d rather focus on more unique projects that are different to what we’ve already done.

And thank you for your kind words!

[b]From Sebastian Pospiech[/b]

[i]“Have you ever run a simulation to find what is the lowest turn number needed for a game to end? Do you run this kind of test with every new DLC?”[/i]

At one point when we were testing loads, we did check that sort of data, might even still be knocking around somewhere… But we do soak-test the game quite a lot, to help check for problems!

[b]From Jeff Persson[/b]

[i]“What is the next Smash Up expansion you are working on and when will it be released to Steam, Google Play and the Apple App Store?”[/i]

Smash Up is a tough one - we’re happy with the adaptation we made but the uptake for players on expansions has been low compared to our other games. We’ve had some people asking for more content, but we need to still make smart decisions of where we put our resources and time development-wise.

So right now the answer is: We’re not working on another Smash Up expansion at the moment!

[b]From Alessandro Salani[/b]

[i]“I read to send questions to you from this on steam... so I took some time to... write to you. First of all let's say that I really love the game of Talisman 4th Edition. I've the board game at home with many physical "DLCs". The online game was a life-saver during previous year and current one, so it's great. I'm full of questions (and feedback) about it! Let's start in order of importance.

This game is lacking a consistent PVE side, are you planning to add more Custom Endings to focus on that? Or allow players to create their own custom ones?

"Remove Drawing Limit Mode". To improve fast-play games I'd LOVE if there will be a mode to remove the drawing card limit from each box.

The Private Online Game Creation allows players to create only one room at once and to continue it even if some day has passed... but what if a player would create more online rooms?

What about adding also Weekly / Monthly challenges? 

"Frog Rush Mode is possible"? This is a mad idea that I'd personally. Add 'Frogs' as Playable characters (removing the restriction to not be able to gain strength or craft or followers and/or other restrictions) and try to reach the crown or an ending... 'that way' ahahah. Maybe that's a little insane but surely funny.

Some cards / spells are different from their Board Game description and effect. I'd like it... for each card that has these 'changes' toggle 'on-off' for changes from Board Game edition.”[/i]

That’s a lot of questions to get through Alessandro! Let’s go through each of them in order:

Our head of QA Michael chimed in on this one: “For more PVE style endings, we did look into doing a ending pack like two years ago, even had a button for it. I think one or two of those endings had a PVE style rules and even a team based PVP one. We’ll have to try and dig out the design document that was made as I recall one of the team based endings being adapted for Talisman: Origins.”

According to Jethro, our resident Talisman man: “that would get very out of hand very quickly!”

Right now this is a limit because of coding reasons, and having to keep track of multiple online saves put a lot of strain on parts of the game that easily break if too much strain is put on them. We do know this is something people want though, so it’s always in the back of our minds!

Another thing we’d like to do! Offering scenarios that players can try to complete that rotate would be cool - we know a lot of other games do ‘daily/weekly runs’ to much success.

This would definitely be possible… but if we should do it is a completely different question!

This would be something else we can look into, as we know there are a lot of die-hard Talisman fans out there who want the game to be exactly 1:1 with the physical game.

[b]And that’s the end of our very first monthly mailbag! Thanks to everyone who sent in questions, and don’t forget to send your questions to questions@nomadgames.co.uk if you want us to answer your burning queries next month![/b]

notes.title: Talisman: Digital Edition Patch Notes - 05/07/2021
notes.content:
Hi Talisman fans! ːblueTalismanː

Today we've rolled out the latest patch for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i]. Check out the official patch notes below, and don't forget to download the update if you want to play with your friends!

[b]General Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the missing SFX for players joining & leaving lobbies
[*] Cross-Region invites should be fixed
[*] Invites should no longer stop working after accepting one
[*] Fixed an issue that happened when 2 players joined lobbies simultaneously
[*] 'Player-Left' message reinstated
[*] Save new lobby preferences after adding/removing players
[*] Fixed space selection sometimes causing a disconnect
[/list]
[b]In-Game Fixes and Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bog (terrain) - No longer draws 2x cards on the space
[*] Cathedral - Correctly draws denizens if drawn on the Cataclysm board
[*] Chapel & Graveyard (Cataclysm) - No longer unable to draw a denizen if your alignment triggered a life to be lost
[*] Glimmer Cloth - No longer works in psychic combat, or when attacked
[*] Holy Blood - fixed synergy with Demons
[*] Shard of the Wild - No longer works for both players in PvP
[*] The Wealthy - fixed being able to choose which fate is gained
[*] The Wealthy - fixed getting a second fate if it's you that gained gold
[*] Undead Hordes - No longer prompted to ignore the effects
[*] Warlock Quests - Should no longer be possible to complete other players Quests
[*] Warlock Quests - Should no longer be possible to complete a quest you've just drawn (and are still choosing which one to replace)
[/list]
[b]Crash Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crash fixed when rejoining games after choosing alternate endings
[*] Crash fixed on player death via PvP
[*] Crash fixed when selecting cards on the board with a controller
[/list]
[b]Fixed several AI 'Lock-ups' in the following places:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Shrine of Kernos
[*] Whilst concealing (with the Living Doll)
[*] Whilst concealing (with the Lodestone)
[*] At Dice with Death (cataclysm version) as the Vampiress
[/list]
As always, thanks for the support everyone! ːheartː

notes.title: Talisman: Digital Edition Patch Notes - 27/05/2021
notes.content:
Hey Talisman fans! ːblueTalismanː

Today we've rolled out a new patch for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i], which improves a bunch of things in the game! The key highlights are:
[list]
[*] End of game stability fixes (We were finally able to consistently recreate this internally, meaning you should now be able to finish games and get your earned EXP!)
[*] Witch Hunter nerfed from 4/4 to 3/3 (We've heard your request to adjust the Witch Hunter as they are too powerful in dedicated PVP scenarios - we'll keep an eye on how people react to him now he's been adjusted)
[*] Fixed losing progress when increasing post-game goals (Along with the end of game stability fixes, this should help make sure you get the right EXP when you finish a game)
[*] Gamepad Board and UI Navigation updated (We've made a couple of improvements to help you get around when using a gamepad, and the UI has also had a few updates)
[*] New Quick-Use menu for Cards in the 'Usable Cards' tab (This is something we've been asked about implementing, so please give it a try and let us know what you think!)
[*] We're hoping that we've also fixed the issue where people's challenge points weren't resetting as they should at the end of the month.
[*] Crash Fixes
[/list]
In more [i]Talisman: Digital Edition news[/i], we've also just announced that we're bringing the game to Xbox! You can read all about it over on our [url=https://nomadgames.co.uk/blog/talisman-xbox-confirmed]official website[/url].

Now, onto the full patch notes!

[h2]UI updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Avatar Page scaling fixed
[*] Some non-existent decks have been hidden from the deck list
[*] Gamepad Board and UI Navigation updated
[*] Gamepad support for navigating 'spaces of interest/possible moves'
[*] Terrain and Beasts no longer show icons on their card backs
[*] Light & Dark-bound characters now work in Russian
[*] Removed keyboard shortcuts for toggling screen modes
[*] Busy-spinner should show whilst challenges are updating
[*] Fixed losing progress when increasing post-game goals
[*] New Quick-Use menu for Cards in the 'Usable Cards' tab
[/list]
[h2]Online updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stability fixes to end of game
[*] Better handling of joining games
[*] Fixed issue when changing regions
[*] Games should no longer be able to have multiple game-owners
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
(Changes)
[list]
[*] Witch Hunter nerfed from 4/4 to 3/3
[*] Resurrection in the Woodland triggers drawing of a Path
[*] Missing turns as a result of losing combat ignores 'cards remaining to encounter' rule
[/list]
(Fixes)
[list]
[*] AI should no longer be able to complete certain challenges on players behalf
[*] Able to complete quests outside of your turn again
[*] Amarok now joins all forms of combat - not just Battles
[*] Astral Spirit is now correctly optional
[*] Astrolabe challenge fixed (again)
[*] Bog wasn't doing 'Draw 1 Card even if there are already any cards in this space.'
[*] Book of the Dead should now wait when it can be used
[*] Boulders Dodged increases when auto-dodged 
[*] Conscription no longer possible in Psychic Combat
[*] Fix for Barrier & Black Ice staying on the board permanently after their caster dies
[*] Flail of Blood's effect no longer triggers when no dice were rolled
[*] Ganymai can no longer bring people back from the dead on 0 lives
[*] Ghosts moving to anticlockwise spaces in the City no longer move clockwise
[*] Harbinger Cards no longer reappear when rolling 3 on his chart
[*] Havenville reveals the Follower given (triggers on-revealed effects)
[*] Lost Warrior & Lost Maiden can no longer destroy undestroyable cards
[*] Merchant can sell items at the Cataclysm Village
[*] Queen Mab's bonuses no longer stack
[*] Swampland now has a minimum of 1 (negative numbers were coming out as 6)
[*] Tapestry Rewoven - should only use your already selected (and only hidden) endings
[*] Tavern Maid pouring drinks to no players issue resolved
[*] Terrain 'reloading issue' fixed
[*] Crash fix when leaving an online game
[*] Crash fix for multi-clicking card 'menu choices' (e.g. wishes)
[*] Crash fix when casting Fiery Retribution
[/list]

notes.title: Talisman Digital Edition Update: 30/03/2021
notes.content:
Hi Talisman fans! ːbluetalismanː

First of all, we're pleased to confirm that we've addressed a startup-crash problem that some players have. [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i] now attempts to continue if a crash occurs when initialising the graphics system and will attempt to use the following APIs:-

[list]
[*] dx11
[*] dx12
[*] opengl
[/list]
If you still have problems with the game crashing when you start it up, or you know which one you want to use, you can add a launch option to Talisman like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/712f953138d9085d4e00d674f9fd160bee7d0341.png[/img]

And the three different launch options are:

   --dx11
   --dx12
   --opengl

Now, onto the patch notes for todays update!

[list]
[*] Several missing Space SFX added in
[*] Fixed a few places where translations were missing
[*] The stat 'Denizens Visited' wasn't triggering correctly
[*] Astrolabe Challenge fixed
[*] Challenges now show their Expiry date even when completed 
[*] Challenges Expiry times should be much more reliable
[*] Challenges no longer determined by local times
[/list]
We've also made a change to the challenge system which means that the time-based challenges now pull information from our own servers instead of the local computer. This should make it fairer to everyone competing to get those tasty challenge points!

notes.title: Challenge Update Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Talisman fans! ːbluetalismanː

We've got a bumper update for you today, as we're officially rolling the [b]Challenge Update[/b] out onto Steam! The biggest feature of this update is the addition of Challenges! By completing challenges, you can earn exclusive avatars and titles to further customise your Talisman profile. Show off your skills or just express yourself to your Talisman buddies! You'll find your challenges under a new tab with all your other profile stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/e6dd4e6fe5eef60d0399ede27969981f50b5eadf.jpg[/img]

We've got challenges that'll rotate daily, weekly and monthly along with permanent challenges that you can keep working towards - some of the permanent ones don't appear until you've made a certain amount of progress though!

Also included in this update are an absolute heap of other improvements, fixes and changes - many of which were requested by you (our awesome community!)

Below you'll find the full, detailed patch notes for this update:

[h2]Miscellaneous Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Signing out keeps you signed out when relaunching
[*] The Game Speed option is now a house rule in online games - a much requested feature!
[*] Achievement: Don't Fear the Reaper now unlocks correctly
[*] Sudden Death (ending) now includes destinies, beast rewards and dragon scales
[*] 'Poison Cards' should be much easier to use now

[/list]
[h2]Statistics Changes[/h2]

[*] New stat 'Goblins killed'

[*] Treasures & Relics weren't counting their other stats (Objects/Talismans)
[*] Eagle King (ending) now counts towards Eagle King defeat count
[*] Cards Burnt stat should work properly now
[*] Character wins/losses should now ignore Toads & Ghosts
[/list]
[h2]Game Logic Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tapestry Rewoven is no longer able to show revealed endings

[*] Queen Mab should now have the correct bonus on subsequent encounters
[*] All other Enemy and Creature combat bonuses are correctly reset
[*] Doomsayer's taking of a Spell is now optional
[*] Life Tap (Spell) better handles players deaths 
[*] Cursed Followers may no longer be ditched at the Ice Bridge
[*] Flail of Blood is no longer permanently in the Active Cards area
[*] Active Cards shouldn't show card backs any more
[*] Felclaw now has the correct stats
[*] Night Gaunt has the correct stats & faces the correct way
[*] Using St George is now optional
[*] The Legendary Horse and Cart hold the correct number of extra Objects
[*] Choosing Path cards should be more reliable
[*] Several Followers have been fixed where they could be used when they shouldn't have been (this fixes a few lock-ups)
[*] Ekor & Shiver Nymph should correctly flee when revealed (if their condition is met)
[*] You should now only gain gold once from character bounties
[*] Brood tokens effect now works correctly with the Queen Crest
[*] Pathfinder 'roll up to move' works during movement roll and not just before
[*] The One Talisman can no longer be lost
[*] Chest (Dungeon) now gives the correct amount of gold
[*] Chest (Dungeon) now also removes the correct amount of lives
[*] Improved Forge Destiny's check for valid targets before casting
[*] Six-Fates Inn no longer shows the Carnival when in use
[*] Player Graves are moved to expansion entrances in endings where they are locked out of the region
[*] Broken Spire now correctly handles results above 12
[*] NPCs can now teleport to the Deep Realms when reaching the end of an Expansion
[*] Movement in the Deep Realms fixed more generally for both players and NPCs
[*] Trophies with abilities should now work correctly
[*] 'Herald based effects' are no longer constrained to just combat dice
[*] 'View Board' option added to several cards
[*] Taking gold from the Treasure Hoard is now optional
[*] Taking multiple Tokens off cards at once should work correctly
[*] Handing in 'Character Bounties' can be delayed until the end of a turn
[*] You can now use Staff of Mastery through your inventory
[*] The game now displays the original square description when rolling for a Card effect that references it (e.g. Temple replaced by terrain when encountering Idol)
[*] Haversack loop has been fixed
[*] Merchant's Trade loop also fixed
[*] Clockwork Guardian loop is also fixed!

[h2]AI Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] AI loop fixed when evaluating a Rusty Boomstick 
[*] AI loop fixed when trying to stash a card with the Scavenger
[*] AI loop fixed with the Conman evaluating gold
[*] AI loop fixed with Artificer's Recycle ability
[*] AI loop fixed using fate to pay for gold to pay for fate

[*] AI no longer gets stuck with the Monster Hunter Denizen
[*] AI is more conservative when using some 'disposable' combat cards
[*] AI no longer ignores Den of Thieves options

[h2]Crash Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash with 'Gain Strength' Warlock Quest

[h2]Other minor changes[/h2]

notes.title: Talisman Challenge Update Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
Hello Talisman fans!

Today we’re going to be giving you a sneak peek at what we’ve been working on for Talisman: Digital Edition over the last few months! Back in September we rolled out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/247000/view/2874940914791334201]Profile Update[/url] which added a bunch of exciting new profile features, including avatars and stat tracking.

As part of our continued commitment to making [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i] the best game it can be, we’ve been working on adding even more features to the game. Which is why we’re excited to announce that our next free update for Talisman will be the [b]Challenge Update[/b]!

This update includes a heap of additions to the profile system we added in September, so we’ve gone over some of the exciting additions you can expect to see below:

[h3]Challenges[/h3]

The most obvious addition with this update are challenges themselves! These are in-game challenges that you can complete whenever you play [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i]. There are challenges for almost everything you can do in the game, along with some harder to earn challenges too. Getting toaded finally has a use!

As long as you’re signed into your Nomad Account, these challenges will be persistent across all your devices as well - so you can work towards your challenges on mobile while you’re away from your computer!

[h3]Timed Challenges[/h3]

We wanted to give all our players a good range of different challenges to complete when we were designing them. That is why we’ve split the challenges into four different types:
[list]
[*] Daily
[*] Weekly
[*] Monthly
[*] Ongoing
[/list]
As you can probably guess, the first three types of challenges reset every day, week and month, respectively. Ongoing challenges will never expire, so you can keep making progress on them without having to worry about completing them within a certain timeframe. These challenges are also colour coded so that you can easily see at a glance what challenges you still need to complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/96e29dd3e9145a5210d9b85a2829eeaddb15dc63.jpg[/img]

If a challenge expires before you complete it, don’t worry - these timed challenges will come around again, you just might have to wait a while! However, any progress you made on that timed challenge will be reset once they roll back around. So if you have to cast 100 spells in a week and you get to 50 then the week ends, that challenge will come back at some point and you'll be on zero.

And as you work on your challenges, you’ll receive a notification at the end of your turn to let you know your current progress. You can see it in the bottom right of the screen, and is an easy way to keep track of your progress as you play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/62364ce5172ff10fe76cc1e1598b8f144dd989e0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Challenge Points[/h3]

Also new with this update are Challenge Points - a special reward you can receive for completing challenges. 

You’ll probably also notice that a lot of these challenges have rosettes next to them. This signifies the kind of reward you’ll earn for completing that challenge! If you take a look at a lot of the timed challenges, you’ll see that they have a rosette with a number inside it. That number signifies how many challenge points you’ll earn for completing that challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/1c0e14170971fffe44dbe7c8b366f1a9b6e99497.jpg[/img]

Different challenges will reward different numbers of points, depending on how difficult the challenge is. But what are challenge points for we hear you ask?

[h3]Challenge Rank[/h3]

As you earn challenge points, your challenge rank will increase. As your challenge rank increases, your standing in the monthly Talisman Challenge ranks will go higher and higher! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/21df72bd59987003e652c583dfe15a5aba1dfac2.jpg[/img]

The Challenge rank is a monthly leaderboard that will reset at the end of every month - we’re hoping that you’ll compete against other challengers and your friends to be the highest rank each month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/86ebe6efc57629cae53bb5f433888faafad00373.jpg[/img]

[h3]Avatars[/h3]

Want to deck out your profile with a cool new look? Back in September we added profile avatars to the game, so you could show off your favourite character. As of this update, you can now unlock new avatars by completing challenges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/325c48053b1a561e0e4818da7e4a9a9da73301d6.jpg[/img]

A number of challenges award exclusive avatars that can only be earned by completing those specific challenges. Not every challenge will reward you with an avatar, but you can tell which ones will by the ‘avatar’ symbol next to them! We hope you all enjoy unlocking new ways to customise your avatar and show off your Talisman prowess!

[h3]Titles[/h3]

Alongside avatars, the [b]Challenge Update[/b] also includes a new way for you to customise your profile - titles! Just like Challenge avatars, these can be unlocked by completing certain challenges. These are all related to the challenge you’ve completed, and we spent a long time making sure there were titles that all Talisman players would appreciate. If you want to be known as the ‘Toad King’ to all your Talisman friends, you’re going to have to work for it!

Unlocked titles appear in a new tab on the profile screen, and will also tell you how you earned them if you unlocked them by completing challenges. We can’t wait for you to see them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/2d3201bafaad7549faaaf1e57e0f897fb665fdb9.jpg[/img]

And finally, this is what your friend list looks like with the new avatar and title system! Like we said, it’s a great way to show off your Talisman achievements or favourite characters to your friends as you play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/7aacbe90a3dafcbc9bcc2be69c7178f1eb518272.jpg[/img]

[h2]So when can we expect to play with this?[/h2]

We’re still working on adding the finishing touches to the [b]Challenge Update[/b] and need to make sure our internal quality assurance team are happy with it. We’ll then need to roll it out on all platforms.

Once we’re close to releasing the update, we’ll shout about it on all our different social media channels, so follow us if you want to be in the know! If you want to stay up to date with the latest [i]Talisman[/i] news, follow us on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/nomad_games/]Instagram[/url] and Discord - or sign up to our [url=https://nomadgames.co.uk/marketing-preferences]newsletter[/url]!

notes.title: Talisman: Digital Edition Update - 19/10/2020
notes.content:
Hello Talisman fans! ːblueTalismanː

We've got another update for you all, this time adding a heap of different fixes and updates to the game to make it a smoother experience for everyone!

[h3]We've rolled out a heap of logic and mechanical fixes, including:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moving by using Eyes of the Hawk / Clockwork Owl has been fixed
[*] Cancelling a burn action cancels properly now (It was incorrectly using either option to proceed)
[*] Chanter type cards have been reworked to use the correct player order
[*] Power Overwhelming now properly checks players have enough Spells when activated
[*] Elixir of Life usability improved (sometimes it'd prompt people to use it when they actually couldn't, e.g. when someone else was losing a life)
[*] Totem Warrior's ability has been fixed
[*] Taking Spells from Arboreal Dragon is now optional
[*] Barbarian can now replenish fate at the Crags, as he should!
[*] Simurgh Feather no longer affects cards drawn by Ifrit Hoard
[*] Legendary Goblin King stats have been fixed
[*] Vengeful Guide was misbehaving when conscripted, we've made it behave itself now
[*] Divine Priestess logic now matches the printed text
[*] Snowdrifts no longer stop if the 'current player' dies
[*] Hand in for trophy related warlock quests fixed
[*] Warlock Quests that are completed immediately (when acquired) no longer prevent you from passing through the Portal of Power
[*] Numerous AI loops and crashes fixed
[/list]

[h3]We've also made some changes to the user interface:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Active cards area moved slightly
[*] Base game 'token places' choices have been modified (e.g. 'Encounter' is now 'Gain 1 Strength')
[*] Dice Bonuses are now more consistently display in combat when given in certain ways (e.g. things that increase your 'roll value')
[*] 'View Board' option added to several cards and spaces
[*] Fireball now shows stat as modifier
[*] All warlock quest cards use their full description in large text mode
[/list]

[h3]And a few other fixes and changes too:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chat filter less strict (in the last update it seemed to have gone overboard, so we've adjusted it)
[*] Users with names that can't be displayed will display their Character name instead
[*] Some of the new stats weren't triggering correctly - they should be now though!
[/list]

If you spot any issues or have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us here on Steam! We're keeping an eye on the forums here for issues that come up, and we're always happy to hear from our fans.

Remember, stay safe, wash your hands and don't get turned into a toad! ːheartː

notes.title: The Talisman Profile Update is now live!
notes.content:
Hi Talisman fans! ːBlueTalismanː

We’ve just released the latest update for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i]!

[b]UPDATE: We've noticed that the Leaderboards feature seems to be having some issues - we're working on a quick fix for this as we speak![/b]

This update features a massive overhaul of how profiles work in Talisman, along with the introduction of Nomad Accounts - which replace and improves upon the Asmodee login system. It also adds avatars, new ranks and a whole heap of leaderboards and stats for you to enjoy. You can read more about what is included in this update over on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/247000/view/2719563557124733390]original announcement blog[/url]. Or head into the game to see the new features for yourself, and then let us know what you think!

As we’re releasing this update on all platforms at the same time, we’re also maintaining cross-platform play between all platforms. Last time we rolled out an update for [i]Talisman: Digital Edition[/i], we know that it made Nintendo Switch players unable to play with their friends on different platforms for a while - we’ve made sure that doesn’t happen again!

And of course, in this update we've included a [b]massive[/b] heap of new bug fixes and other improvements including quality of life/functional improvements:

[list]
[*] We've added a new house rule - you can adjust the default trophy trade-in values

We've also fixed a whole heap of things we've spotted and that have been reported by the community:

[list]
[*] Cataclysm Quests can now be completed properly

[*] Stables now use the correct prices for legendary cards

[*] Miner (follower) wasn't checking gold correctly - we've improved his gold checking skills
[*] Thief wasn't able to steal when there was a denizen on the village
[*] Ancient Artefact bonus will now go to battle roll correctly
[*] Drawing Wyrd Path via Faerie Trod wasn't putting a destiny on it
[*] Stone of Lia Fal and Wyrd Path destiny issues fixed
[*] Auspice can now be used properly
[*] Reordered player initialisation
[*] Kallind doesn't go to the inner region anymore
[*] Deep Realm no longer turns itself off each launch
[*] Several places were checking if players could 'gain' and not 'replenish' fate
[*] Several abilities reworked with Crown of Command (CoC) restrictions
[*] Teleports triggered whilst on CoC no longer work (e.g. You encountered a card last turn that teleports you this turn but you're now on the CoC)
[*] Fixed issue with board appearing behind game setup
[*] Fixed issue mimicking alignment when drawing tokens (The was causing issues with the Witch Hunter)
[*] Fixed issue with several abilities not working when 'shape-shifted in to'
[*] Fixed issue playing Battle music
[*] Fixed board sounds playing after quitting
[*] Several AI lockups fixed
[/list]

If you notice anything that hasn't been fixed, we're probably still working on it! And if you notice something you think hasn't been reported yet, feel free to post it in the 'Bug Report' forum here on Steam. ːheartː

notes.title: Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition is coming to Steam
notes.content:
Hello Talisman fans! ːBlueTalismanː

As many of you will already know, here at Nomad Games we specialise in bringing iconic and much-loved board games to life digitally. Our next title that will be landing on Steam is [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i], another classic Games Workshop board game that defined the social-deduction genre and has enthralled players for nearly 40 years with it's unique gothic horror atmosphere.

We've got a bit more to go before the game is ready, but we'll be ramping up all our efforts massively in the next few months.

If you're interested, please take a look at the Steam page for [i]Fury of Dracula[/i]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/958530/Fury_of_Dracula_Digital_Edition/

If you're [b]extra[/b] interested, then why not add the game to your Steam wishlist?

[h2]Why should you wishlist Fury of Dracula on Steam?[/h2]

Steam has a lot of games on it. We mean a LOT of games. [url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/steam/games-released-in-2019]More than 8,000 games were added to Steam in 2019 alone.[/url] And it isn't showing any signs of slowing down soon.

In order to cope with this flood of games onto the platform, those cool kids at Valve have been pushing the use of algorithms that decide what players want to see, and what is worth showing to you. One of the key ways that Valve decides what is worth showing is based on the number of players who wishlist that title.

As a tiny studio who make niche titles, it’s massively important to us that our audience sees our games amongst the flood of competing titles. By adding [i]Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition[/i] to your wishlist, not only are you helping us reach you directly, you’re also helping other people find out about our game too.

Wishlist figures also help us get an idea of how we can expect a title to perform, and allow us to make much better decisions about our future. It’s a win-win!

Also, if you add Fury of Dracula: Digital Edition to your wishlist, we’ll think you’re really cool. And can you really put a price on that?

notes.title: What's next for Talisman: Digital Edition?
notes.content:
Hi Talisman fans! ːBlueTalismanː

As we’re sure you all noticed, we recently updated the main menu for Talisman: Digital Edition to make it look a lot nicer and easier to use. Well, we’ve not finished updating Talisman yet! We’re ready to give you all a look at what we’ve got planned next for Talisman, in our upcoming profile update.

[h2]So what have we got planned for this update?[/h2]

[i]Notice something different about the main menu? What’s that in the bottom right corner?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/3a4253668708feeb36963a29180737f896efb13d.jpg[/img]

Currently the only thing that your profile does in Talisman: Digital Edition is level up to unlock runestones, and keep track of some in-game achievements. We’ve been working hard to overhaul the profile system in order to give you loads more customisation options and stats.

[h2]Nomad Games Account[/h2]

Last year we mutually agreed with Asmodee that they would no longer publish our titles, and we would return to self-publishing. [url=https://www.nomadgames.co.uk/blog/nomad-games-returns-to-self-publishing]You can read more about that on our website if you missed it![/url] They were kind enough to allow us to continue to use the Asmodee login system while we worked on a replacement for the system, and now that system is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/788e2bdf83ee3ed581e22e5a4ce69f9644d8823f.jpg[/img]

Not only does the Nomad Games Account system do everything that the Asmodee login did (sync your purchases across Steam and mobile, keep track of your stats) it also allows you to access this new profile system!

Having a Nomad Games Account makes it much easier for our support team to identify issues you might be having, so it’s a win-win!

[i]Please note that we still won’t be able to offer purchase syncing across the Nintendo Switch or PS4 versions of Talisman, due to restrictions on those platforms.[/i]

[h2]Avatars[/h2]

Want to show off who your favourite Talisman character is? Or just want to look cool in front of all your friends? In this new update, you’ll be able to choose an avatar for your profile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/0b7a4fa5e68f7dceb85304a3291a387eb1282a87.jpg[/img]

While some avatars will be unlocked from the start, we’re hoping to add even more as time goes on. We’ll share more about them as we get closer to release!

[h2]Latest News[/h2]

Worried you might miss out on the latest Talisman news? With our new ‘News’ section we’ll be able to share the latest Talisman updates, tips and announcements with you directly.

[h2]Stats[/h2]

Do you want to know more about your Talisman playing habits then you could have ever asked for? Well have we got good news for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/daf4921cd9849d0c5dd30325d7dd9fa7800b4863.jpg[/img]

We’ve added a whole heap of new things that the game will track, so you’ll finally be able to know just how many times you’ve played as the Leprechaun, or how many times you’ve rolled a 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/8c3eb88653a8908bbaa8daf2b780bb77b42c4ad6.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Leaderboards[/h2]

And along with all these exciting new stats comes exciting new leaderboards! A lot of the stats you saw above also have leaderboards associated with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/8ea9dc8312f1cb548f9bffd1a71e5823bd9d6d83.jpg[/img]

Want to be the No.1 Talisman player in the world when it comes to being turned into a toad? Think you can beat the mighty 'NomadTest3'? Now is the time to prove it!

[h2]Friend Stats[/h2]

Want to compare yourself against your friends? We won’t judge if you want to start bragging, honest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/1e158275cd3d1ac09038be400a69773d1522eb67.jpg[/img]

Right now this function is only to show you their stats, however we’re hoping to eventually add the ability to invite people to games directly from your friends list. That’ll take a bit more development though!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5076051/425e7abb2f148de0e37c528c4a00018a6152dda3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Will I need to pay for any of this?[/h2]

Nope! All you need is to sign up for a Nomad Games Account and you’ll have full access to all the features listed above. You also won’t be able to purchase avatars - we’ll share more about how exactly you’ll be able to get them at a later date.

Please note that if you don’t want to sign up for an account, you’ll still be able to play Talisman as before - you just won’t have access to these extra profile features or cross-platform purchase syncing.

[h2]When will this be released?[/h2]

As you can see from these screenshots, we're pretty close to releasing it! Right now we’re in the process of running final tests on these new features, and then we’ll need to make sure that everything works correctly on multiple devices. We're not 100% sure how long this process will take, so stay tuned for more updates.

As soon as the update is ready to release, we’ll be shouting about it on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/nomad_games/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/nomadgames]official Discord[/url] - if you want to make sure you don’t miss out, follow us on your preferred social media content engagement platform! (Unless your preferred platform is Myspace, sorry but we haven't got one of those)

notes.title: Legendary Decks + New Characters OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi Talisman fans! ːBlueTalismanː

We're very excited to announce that we've just released a batch of new content for Talisman: Digital Edition! This new content includes:

[list]
[*] 4 new Legendary Decks available for players to purchase
[*] 3 new characters available for players to purchase
[*] A cool new look for the main menu
[*] A heap of bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

[h2][b]What are Legendary Decks?[/b][/h2]

If you’ve not already seen or heard, Legendary Decks will take your game of Talisman to the next level by making the game more challenging than ever before. Legendary Decks are mixed into your normal Adventure Cards, with the new cards offer harder challenges for you to overcome.

Please note that in order to use a Legendary Deck for a certain expansion, you’ll need to first own the expansion that the Legendary Deck is associated with. e.g. to use [i]‘The Reaper: Legendary Deck’[/i] you’ll need to first own [i]‘The Reaper Expansion’[/i] for Talisman: Digital Edition.

[h2][b]Who are these new characters?[/b][/h2]

We've brought three classic characters from the early days of Talisman to live in our digital adaptation! They are:

[b]The Ranger[/b], a skilled hunter and tracker who has spent years in the wilds hunting dangerous monsters and foes. He is now setting his sights on the most dangerous prize of all… the Crown of Command!

[b]The Witch Hunter[/b] believes evil has taken root in the world, and it’s his job to hunt it! The Witch Hunter has a legion of villagers at his back, ready to put the accused on trial for their crimes.

[b]The Swordsman[/b] is ready to unsheathe his blade and battle across the land of Talisman! Years of training have made the Swordsman an expert of the blade, and now he looks to put those skills to use in the race towards the Crown of Command.

[h2][b]I want to buy ALL the Legendary Decks! How do I do that?[/b][/h2]

Good question! We put together a bundle of Legendary Decks here on Steam so you can get them at a discount if you were planning on picking up the whole lot.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/14952/]Check out the Legendary Deck Collection here![/url]

[h2][b]I already have all the characters, can I get a discount?[/b][/h2]

You sure can! We've added these new characters to our 'All Characters Bundle' on Steam, so you can complete your collection at a discount.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10257/]Check out the Complete Character Collection here![/url]

[h2][b]My bug still isn't fixed in this update![/b][/h2]

While this patch will hopefully fix a fair number of known bugs (the online connection issues should be fixed in this patch for example) we know Talisman well enough to say that we've definitely not squished all of them yet. We're always working on further bug fixes, and if we didn't fix yours this time then we're still working on it.

If a bug is still present in this update and you haven't posted it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/247000/discussions/1/]Bug Report forum[/url], please do!

We hope you all enjoy this new content, and if you've got feedback you can get in touch with us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/nomadgames]Discord[/url]! ːheartː

notes.title: Announcing Legendary Decks + New Characters!
notes.content:
Hey Talisman fans! ːBlueTalismanː

We’re excited to announce our latest batch of content for Talisman: Digital Edition! On May 7th we'll be bringing you 4 'Legendary Decks' and 3 new characters to play with! These will be able to purchase through Steam, and each Legendary Deck will require you to have the associated expansion in order to be used.

[h2]What are Legendary Decks?[/h2]

If you’ve been looking for your next challenge in Talisman: Digital Edition, and want to ramp up the difficulty of your next game then this is just for you. Each Legendary Deck replaces selected Adventure Cards from the associated expansion with new, tougher versions of the Adventure Cards.

Legendary Decks are mixed into your normal Adventure Cards; however, the cards offer harder challenges for you to overcome. The classic Strength 7 Dragon will now tower above you as a Strength 15 Dragon.

[h2]How do they work?[/h2]

At present we plan to make a Legendary Decks for all Talisman Expansions. At launch we will only be releasing 4 decks however, these will be for the Base Game and the following expansions: The Dungeon, The Highland, and The Reaper.

To play with the Legendary Decks, you’ll need to own the expansions that they are related too. Then you’ll simply have to turn them on before you start a game and they’re shuffled into the normal Adventure Deck.

[h2]Who are these new characters?[/h2]

These three characters are returning favourites from earlier versions of Talisman, that we've updated for Digital Edition. From May 7th, you'll be able to purchase and play as:
[list]
[*]The Swordsman
[*] The Ranger
[*] The Witch Hunter
[/list]

If you want to find out more about Legendary Decks or these new characters you can see all their details on our [url=https://www.nomadgames.co.uk/blog/talisman-legendary-decks-announced]website[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - v. 71730
notes.content:
Hello all,

A new update is now live – v. 71730.

We're not gonna do our usual super formatting for this patch as we've only got a few logic fixes. 

The major thing that comes with this update is controller support and online stability fixes. 

If you plug your controllers in there should be fully mapped support. We'll include a controller map layout image in the next patch, but for now you should be able to use your controllers. Plug them in and have a play!

We've spent ages working on online stability fixes that has led us down some pretty deep and dark rabbit holes that led to some new and improved stability bugs but we think we're on top of that now. We should see less dropouts and less trouble rejoining/resuming games across all platforms. We're very focused on online stability at the moment so if you continue to have issues then please let us know. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New music for battles and psychic combat.
[*]Text spill cleaned up if there are multiple winners for the Runic Revolution ending.
[*]Ghosts now respect Gauntlet rules in the Inner Region.
[*]Ruined City now correctly discards after taking a card from the purchase deck.
[*]Village Mystic is now correctly placed if you draw them through the Meeting Place card.
[*]Chivalric Knight should be able to encounter other players through the Spiteful Imp card.
[*]The Black Knight Denizen should discard correctly when on a Terrain card.
[*]Warlord should no longer get +1 Craft per conscripted follower.
[*]Restless Dead should correctly apply to Spirits and Undead enemy types if they're drawn through Metamorph.
[*]You should correctly get gold from the Cataclysm Treasure Chest.
[/list]

As always, thanks for all the support. <3

If you'd like to discuss this patch or anything else Talisman related, the best place is on our official Discord: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/nomadgames]https://discordapp.com/invite/nomadgames[/url]
