notes.title: Update - 28th March
notes.content:
New feature - My Collection
As the game expands and we add more and more content to it, it's good to have a screen which shows you all of the content you've purchased plus anything you're missing. The 'My Collection' screen has been added and it doubles as a store screen and a card browser. The Warlock Quest cards are currently missing from the browser, but they will be added.

Usability - we've changed it so that if you single-click a board space when choosing where to move, the game will not zoom-in. You can still manually zoom-in/out with the mouse wheel and by using the magnifying glass button. Double-clicking a movement option will move you there as before.

Fixes...

General AI - huge improvement with regards to special ability usage and other decision making. Also, the AI now behaves according to any House Rules being used, i.e: More likely to take a life instead of an object in Bloodbath mode and less likely to look for healing with the 'No More Lives' rule.
AI will now cast Counterspell, if available, if a player casts Transference on them whilst they're on the Crown of Command.
AI will wait to see if the Hydra or Cave Troll are really killed before casting Reflection.
Minstrel was able to use his charmed animal followers twice per battle.
Typo on Summon Bear card.
Player would sometimes gain a life after killing a non-enemy with the Runesword.
Number of missed turns when using the Instructor is now correct.
We've disabled tutorial messages popping-up during online games. It's possible they were causing some crashes.
Fireball spell wasn't including any Craft modifiers.
Jester follower wasn't always working correctly - Standoffs would be classed as wins.
Resuming a saved game after casting Temporal Warp now recognises how many turns you've had.
Character Select house rule - the three character cards are now centrally placed.
Crash when cancelling using the Druid Staff.
Crash when using the Alchemist follower on any object being used, such as the Orb of Destiny.
Can now cast Barrier even if teleport options are available.
House Rules list didn't update text when the language was changed.
Runestones can be equipped from the front-end 'Profile' area.
Life/Fate are now not gained if you beat an enemy with the Runesword/Fate Stealer and someone casts Preservation.
Fixed a bug where a player on the Valley of Fire space could attack a character on the Crown space.
If Sleep was cast on the Sage whilst he was viewing the top cards of the decks, he could no longer use that ability for the rest of the game.
Players carrying the Amulet would not win a 'Race to the Crown' game until they ditched the Amulet.
Tutorial for building a Raft with an Axe was appearing at the wrong time.

We've changed Bloodbath mode so that alignment restrictions are lifted when attacking other characters. If you played as the Knight you could not attack a good character which would make Bloodbath very difficult if a good character had the Talisman. It is Bloodbath after all, so players should be fighting it out! We'll look at returning the Talisman Adventure deck cards soon too, due to popular demand.

notes.title: Update - 3rd March
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here's the first post-release update! 

Fixed...

AI players will now use the Auto-Open option at the Portal of Power, if available.

AI Sage is more likely to use his re-roll to move ability, if his first movement options were bad selections.

Fixed an issues where AI players would use the Alchemist follower on all of a player's objects in online games, if a player takes too long with their turn.

Merchant AI is improved.

Follower gained from the Staff of Mastery moves with the Staff if it is taken.

The Exorcist achievemennt works correctly.

Sage character could not use the Orb of Destiny correctly when rolling for movement.

Missed turns now taken into account during Temporal Warp turns.

DLC can be used correctly when you aren't logged into Steam.

Priest + Monk can now use weapons in Psychic Combat.

Merchant could not pay to evade the Lord of the Pit if the Craft option was chosen.

Merchant could not choose how to fight the Cerberus a second time if he paid to evade it the first time.

Fixed being able to cast Nullify on yourself if it is your only spell.

Rod of Ruin used immediately before combat now affects the attack score.

notes.content:

notes.title: Update - 14th February
notes.content:
Fixes - 

Misdirection now works correctly on spaces where characters aren't moving, such as the Plain of Peril and being stranded at the Temple.

Crash - casting Reflection after someone casts Fireball.

Golden Statue is now shown being taken if you're forced to take it after combat.

Enrich spell was affecting roll results on the Shrine card.

Could see other players spell draws after all spells had been used and the deck reshuffled.

The Reaper's teleport option now works.

AI was unable to ditch spells when it was forced to.

'Before you move' spells couldn't be cast if you re-roll for movement.

AI tweaks - mainly Raft creation and usage, Destruction and Displacement spell targets.

Some followers couldn't be used if they were chosen from your inventory rather than from the play area.

notes.title: Update - 11th February
notes.content:
New feature -
Using objects and followers is now presented in the same way as spells, so it's easier to see what other players are doing. 

Fixes - 
Some memory issues.

Invisible cards on the board if Destruction is Countered.

Spell cards flipping around when opponents roll attack dice.

AI would sometimes cast Counterspell to counter a Counterspell after the Command Spell.

Priest and Knight pray score increase buttons moved as they were sometimes covered by cards.

Disabled network logging - we've switched off creation of log files during online games, in case it helps with lag or other slowdown.

Fixed a crash when minimising the game as it is loading.

A message would appear to state the Warlock had given you a Talisman after completing a quest, even if there were none in the deck.

Crash - trying to re-roll your attack die before the re-roll option appeared.

If a card is being selected from a large collection, such as someone ditching a card when they have many, or when choosing a Warlock Quest, the card can now be seen by other players.

Reaper killing a player was affecting the next player's movement.

Genie spells cannot be Nullified.

Crash - if you encountered the Casket and missed a turn whilst on the Death space.

Auto-kills were sometimes reported as stand-offs.

Fixed getting turned into a toad if the Crone beats your Summon.

Fixed a used Elixir being placed on a space if drinking it takes your last life.

The Flying Carpet now needs to be used like other objects - double-click it in the Play Area to use it.


We have made a small change to how the save files work, so you will notice that your settings will have reset to default values.

notes.title: Update - 7th February
notes.content:

Crash when viewing inventories (pressing Tab) - fixed.

Auto-lose option added - if you're having a fight against creatures and you cannot possibly win, an Auto-Lose option appears to speed things up.

Two summon spells could be cast during combat - fixed.

Enchant Blade works on magic weapons - REALLY THIS TIME.

Warhorse - the rule for losing the Warhorse is now correct, it will be discarded when you lose a life.

notes.title: Update - 6th February
notes.content:
Long list of fixes...

Memory issues have been improved. If you've seen error messages regarding memory and bucket sizes, these should hopefully be fixed. It would happen after a long game, when you view a player's cards.

Gust of Wind now doesn't work on a player with the Amulet.

Mesmerism - wrong player was being selected.

Flying Carpet lets you move between regions using the 6 roll.

Extra Prophesy card removed.

Auto-Zoom option works correctly, zooming out after combat.

Game log correctly lists rolls on cards, such as Random. 

Being able to encounter a space after a stand-off - fixed.

Cannot take objects via the Crypt Keeper if your alignment doesn't allow it.

Black Unicorn now longer taken as a follower if Resurrection was cast to make the combat a stand-off.

Enchant Blade spell now works on Magic Objects which are weapons.

Increased the amount of experience points gained for each reward.

Magic Objects which are weapons work against the Stone Golem.

Couldn't move the Reaper if you rolled a 1 and then bribed a Bandit - fixed.

Could cast Immobility on a player with the Amulet, then that player would be stuck - fixed.

Rolling 1 to move to the Temple and then rolling 5 to be stranded resulted in not being able to move the Reaper - fixed.

Queued spells would automatically be queued if they came back round when the deck is reshuffled.

The Prophetess has put some heels on - her miniature is now 5% taller.

Dark Cultist - after completing a 'Kill an Enemy' Warlock Quest, the Dark Cultist would get stuck if the enemy was a Spirit.

Succubus card now displays Craft counters to show the bonus she receives.

Warhorse and Fiend Slayer followers are now discarded if you lose combat, even if you are saved by armour.

The Prince and Princess followers can be returned to the Castle at the same time.

Cannot avoid losing followers or lives at the Vampire's Tower by highlighting followers and then cancelling.

Astral Conjunction would cause a crash if it was drawn and any player had been killed.

Crash would occur if you quit a game whilst viewing inventory cards in an offline game.

Increased the amount of experience points gained for each reward.

notes.title: Update - 4th February - New Languages Added!
notes.content:
We've added French, German, Spanish and Italian text. We would appreciate those of you fluent in these languages checking all text and letting us know of any errors. Please use the in-game report button to let us know about them. Use the Language/Text error option on the report form.

There are some instances of text we haven't translated yet, and this text begins with XXXX. We know about those, so please don't report them. 
Also, Spanish character descriptions haven't been added yet.
Polish text is currently being worked on and will be added later.

Bug fixes -

Crash when double-clicking to place a spell card - fixed.

Crash when a player comes back to life as a Knight and there aren't enough Swords or Armour in the purchase deck - fixed.

Crash when casting Psionic Blast when the weapon selector is displayed - fixed.

Runesword now gives a life if you use Auto-Kill.

Prophesy now works on the same turn it was encountered.

The rules for encountering Cerberus are now correct - you must land on the Portal of Power space to attack it, and cannot choose to move through the portal whilst Cerberus is still in play.

You are no longer forced to cast the Command spell if you are at the Crown of Command with the Knight.

Arena now works properly.

You cannot use the Hearth Rune if you are already on your start space.

You cannot choose to make the Grim Reaper visit you if you roll a 5 on his chart.

Merchant can now pay to evade the Trapper correctly.

Fixed a bug where choosing to not encounter the Academy meant you would not encounter any cards drawn with it.

Online - the space description tab now automatically shows the description of the space the current player has moved to.

Sleep spell can now be cast whilst you have teleport options.

Rod of Ruin - fixed a bug where it could be used during combat.

Fixed being unable to double-click cards in the play area. This would only happen if you had more than 2 cards in the play area and were trying to double-click any except the first two.

AI players would sometimes choose to re-roll their attack against the Trapper card, which they're not allowed to do - fixed.

Fixed encountering an Object if it was drawn with the Trapper and you evade him.

notes.title: Update - 30th January
notes.content:
New features - 

Online lobby text chat.
Killed players can now leave an online game with their XP intact if another player is at the Crown of Command.
Spellcasting has had a makeover. The caster, spell and any targets are displayed in a way which makes it easier to understand.
You can now choose a weapon to use before combat if you have more than you can use.

Fixes -
Destroy Magic is now castable at the end of your turn.
Crash when the Sage views the top cards and a deck is empty - fixed.
'Row your Boat' acheivement now doesn't unlock when Water Walking is cast.
Immortal, Unbeliever + Royal Entourage achievements fixed.
Sage could cast Displacement after his second movement roll and move a card to a movement option.
Crash when completing the 'Visit City' Warlock's Quest - fixed.
Barrier spell blocked the Reaper's movement - fixed.
'Start of turn' spell casting against AI players improved.
Merchant could give players objects they can't have, such as alignment based objects - fixed.
Orb of Destiny icons less obstructive.
Staff of Mastery - enslaved enemies were displayed before psychic battles but weren't usable - fixed.
Crash when using the online text chat and using the cursor keys to edit your text - fixed
Pathfinder teleporting is now optional.
Spellcasting improvement - previously, you couldn't cast or queue a spell from the play area if there was an animation playing, such as dice rolling. Although we don't allow you to cast spells during these animations, the spell will now queue-up and be cast as soon as possible.
Flying Carpet - you can now use the Carpet OR move 6 spaces in the normal way.
Pathfinder - teleporting is now optional. Roll the movement die to move in the normal way.
You now don't have to ditch an Object to pick up the Concealed Pouch, if you have 4. objects.
Fixed an issue where the Warrior could win a battle that should have been a stand-off.
AI will not take the Familiar follower if it only has one life remaining.
Sage can draw a spell at the start of his turn if his movement is restricted.
Dark Cultist gaining a reward after Resurrection cast on defeated enemy - fixed.
Some general AI fixes.

Important Notes - 
The biggest cause of online desynch issues at the moment is if players take to long over their turn and the AI takes over. Whilst we get these issues fixed, it's recommended that you set online timeouts to be quite high to minimise this happening. Also, try to avoid having AI players in an online game if possible.

If you cast a spell which requires you to place a card on the board, such as Hex, Barrier or Displacement, DO NOT double-click the target space as this causes a crash. This was found too late to fix for this update.

notes.title: Update - 23rd January
notes.content:
New additions - 
Achievements! There are 50 achievements for you to unlock - some simple, some very challenging!
Camera now zooms to the Temple space when the Idol card is encountered.
The Market, Market Day and Village Blacksmith list of cards to purchase now just shows one of each card. When you purchase one, a new one is added, if available.
The number of tokens or gold pieces on the board is now indicated by a number, visible when zoomed-in on the space.
Enable All/Disable All filters options for the game log.

List of fixes...
Network de-synchronisation and 'unmatched choice' issues improved. If you see an 'unmatched choice' error in a network game, please let us know.
Memory overwrite issues in networks games fixed - the longer a network game went on, the more chance it would crash due to memory issues.
Spells which can be cast before a character moves now work correctly. Previously they could only be cast before the movement die was rolled.
'Start of turn' spells can now be cast in the Inner Region when moving towards the Plain of Peril.
Haunt + Jester modifiers now affect Psychic Combat.
Crash when an AI Druid draws a spell fixed.
Fate tokens removed from the board when the Pool of Fortune is removed.
Haunt not taken as a follower if you you beat her but you have the Hag.
Golden Statue cannot be sold when it isn't your turn.
Staff of Mastery doesn't work on spirits.
Grim Reaper's card text tweaked to make roll result 2 clearer.
Flying Carpet now works.
Improved AI use of the Druid Staff.
Priest cannot use the Fate Stealer weapon.
Alteration now works when drawing more than one card.

notes.title: Update - 14th January
notes.content:
Hi All,
Thanks for all of the feedback from last Friday's update. We've been hard at work fixing most of the issues. 

New Feature -

Cards in effect - Whenever a card is affecting the game in some way, a small version of the card appears on the left of the screen. For instance, if you have the Water Bottle and you roll for movement and have a Desert space as a move option, the Water Bottle will appear on the left to remind you that you can safely travel there. Warlock Quests will also be shown here for the current player, to remind you of the quest they are on.

Reaper Fixes - 
Rolling a 4 on the Reaper card and missing 2 turns instead of 1 is fixed.
Earthquake card now removes counters from the board for cards such as Magic Stream.
Riding Horse bug fixed - could only use it once and sometimes using it would hang the game.
Arena crash - we were unable to repeat this after many attempts so let us know if it's still an issue. If it happens to you, please give us as much information as possible.
Moving the Reaper whilst stranded at the Temple or Idol is now fixed.
Fixed using the Elixir of Might twice by double-clicking it before encountering it.
Warrior was unaffected by the Goblin Trapsmith's rule.
Reaper expansion can now be used when you're not logged in to Steam.
Dominate Spell can now only be cast on the Cerberus when you encounter it at the Portal of Power.
Reaper movement made easier - you can now single-click a space and choose 'Move Reaper Here', as well as double-clicking.
Transference Spell now works in the Inner Region (nasty!).
Lord of the Pit - fixed not being asked for the combat type the second time you encounter it.
Destruction Spell on the Staff of Mastery crash fixed.
Transmute and Shatter Spells worked against characters with the Amulet - fixed.
Magician - fixed an issue that allowed you to gain huge amounts of Strength or Craft by cancelling the number selector.

Known issue - The Flying Carpet card doesn't work in this build. Rolling a 6 for movement doesn't allow you to move anywhere within the region.

General fixes -
Players leaving online games is handled better. 
When a player takes too long during their turn, the AI will control the rest of their turn for them rather than controlling each choice after a countdown ends. Because of this, higher timeouts are recommended when creating games.
Couldn't use the Tavern ferry if you had the Poltergeist - fixed.
Other players could choose certain menu options for you in an online game - fixed.
Text chat now allows for longer lines of text and handles breaks better.
AI raft-building is improved. They should no longer get stuck in a loop building rafts.
We've added a delay before AI players roll to move, giving players a greater chance to cast 'start of their turn' spells.
Fixed being able to skip fighting another character at the Crown of Command if there were cards on the space.

New bits -
All Filters On - New advanced option, switches on all game log filters at the start of each game.
New Auto-Open option when opening the Portal of Power and you cannot fail.
Your monitor size is auto detected and added to the list of available resolutions in the settings.
Assassin - if you choose Assassinate and you cannot lose the battle, Auto-Kill appears as an option.

notes.title: New Update - Will you look Death in the eye?
notes.content:
This new update allows those of you with access to the Reaper expansion to play it! Customers who purchased the Gold or Platinum pre-order packs from us will have the Reaper pack available. Note - Please be aware that as with the base game, there are bugs in the Reaper pack and we are fixing them right now, but please let us know about anything you find.

Online games with the Reaper pack - the Reaper expansion pack will be available to use in online games if any player in the lobby owns the pack. A game's host must switch it on for it to be used. When not playing Classic Rules mode, only the owner of the pack can choose to play as the Reaper characters.

Other new features -
The welcome return of the text chat and Auto-Join features for online games.
Browsing cards when it isn't your turn is also back.
Game Log - If you press the small Down/Up arrow near the Adventure deck, this will open a log of everything happening in the game. You can use the list of filters on the right to switch on or off messages about specific actions in the game. They all default to off, so switch on the ones you want to see.

Advanced options - Within the Options screen there is now an Advanced Options button. In here you can set the speed of the AI, from 1 (slow) to 10 (fast).

Pause Button - If you're playing the AI and a card is drawn which you want to read, you can pause the action by holding down the PAUSE key on your keyboard. Let go of the key to continue. This works for most actions in the game, not just when cards are drawn.

Statistic Colours - Strength, Craft, Lives and Fate numbers now change colour based on whether or not they've increased above the start value (Green), decreased below the start value (Red, Fate and Lives only) or white when they are the same as the start value. This makes it easier to see at a glance who has gained or lost stats so you can choose targets for certain spells and objects.

Lots of bug fixes.
The game now handles players leaving an online game better. There is a 10 second wait if the host leaves whilst a new host is determined.
Moving from the Tavern to the Temple using the ferry now works correctly.
Most importantly, the game now works again on Windows XP!

notes.title: New Update! Text Chat and more...
notes.content:
We've added these new features to the game - 

Online Game Auto-Join - To fix the problem of creating an online game and then waiting for players to join, you can now check the option 'Join the next available X player game'. When you press this, you can then go off and play an offline game and when an online game is available and full of other players you will automatically join it. This is still work in progress and so there might be some issues with it.

Online text chat! - The context area now has 3 tabs on the right, Space Description, Usable Cards and Online Chat. You can use the Online Chat tab to talk to other players. The feather icon will glow when there is a new message.

Tooltips - There are now tooltips for most UI elements. Hover your mouse over a button or icon and you will see a tip to tell you what it is.

Browsing Cards - You can now view any cards at any time. Click the card to view it and it will display over the current actions.

You can now choose not to encounter cards on the Crown of Command space and skip straight to casting the Command Spell. Hurrah!

We haven't fixed the issue which prevents the game from loading on an XP machine but it is currently being investigated.

As always, let us know what you think of these new features and thanks for all of the feedback so far. 

Nomad Games would like to wish you all a merry Christmas and we hope that those of you of Good alignment get what you want.

notes.title: Update #4: Let Battle Commence!
notes.content:
[h1]Online multiplayer comes to Talisman![/h1]

This update adds the much anticipated online multiplayer feature, along with many more fixes and features.

[b]New Features - [/b]
[list]
[*] Online Multiplayer!
[*] Public and Private games. Invite option works but the person being invited must already have the game running before they accept.
[*] Voice chat. Be excellent to each other! If someone isn't being excellent, press the speaker icon next to their portrait to mute them. Press your own speaker to stop others hearing you (recommended if you're munching on pretzels).
[*] Online game with human/AI players mix - you can have AI players in your online game. For instance, if you create a 4-player game and start the game with only 3 slots full, the AI will occupy the last slot.
[*] Timeout setting - the host of a game can choose how long each player has to make decisions. If a player does nothing before the timer runs out, they will forfeit their turn.
[*] AI players will take over if human players leave or lose their network connection. There is no message to let you know when someone has left. We will add this soon.
[*] Classic Rules - as with offline games, the host can switch on Classic Rules on the game setup screen and Runestones will not be used.
[/list]
IMPORTANT NOTE - joining and creating games is more stable if you have just loaded the game. Please reboot the game between games if you play more than one. This will be fixed.
[list]
[*] Equipping Runestones on the game setup screen - for both online and offline games, players can change which Runestones are being used by characters on the setup screen. Each character has three Runestone slots next to their character card. Click the slots to edit Runestones for your character and AI players too.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes and Tweaks -[/b]

Big change to spell functionality - After much feedback from you guys, we've changed how spells work so that countering them is more like the board game. You can now see the target of the spell before you are able to cast Counterspell. At the moment, it's a little confusing as to what's happening when a spell is being cast, but we're working on improvements. 
It now works like this -
1) Player 1 casts Destruction and chooses a card on a space.
2) The other players can see the card being chosen (but not which spell is being cast, we'll fix this).
3) When Player 1 confirms the card they want to destroy, the Destruction spell card appears and players have the chance to counter it.
Let us know what you think of this new system.

Tutorials Off button - on the options screen, press the 'Turn Tutorials Off' button to switch off all tutorial text. There is no confirmation when you press this. If you want tutorial messages back, press the 'Reset Tutorial Pop-ups' button.

Talisman cards from the Talisman deck are now visually different to the Talisman cards from the Adventure deck.

Immobility tidy-up - When this is cast, you now have two options - 'Select Player' and 'Select Creature'. If cast on a player, it MUST be cast on the player whose turn it is, they will then miss their turn. If you choose 'Select Creature', you can select any creature which then cannot be attacked for that turn, by clicking the space they are on and then choosing them.

Auto-Kill button labelled - when the Auto-kill option is available, because you cannot lose the current fight, the button now says 'Auto-kill' rather than 'Continue'. This won't appear for character vs. character fights.

New message added - a reminder message appears if you have the Amulet and you're about to enter the Crown of Command space.

Encountering Bandits - rather than a left/right value selector arrow, there is now a 'Bribe' option which will pay him off.

Fixed AI characters turning back in the Inner Region when they could go to the Crown of Command.
Trading in trophies - the AI should now be better at trading in trophies, instead of turning in too many.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update #3: Introducing Runestones
notes.content:
This update is a big one! Loads of new features have been added, here's the list...

XP - You will now earn experience points after each completed game, based on your performance. If you quit a game before the end you will NOT earn any XP.

Player Profile - There is now a Profile button which takes you to a screen where you can set your preferred character and monitor your progress.

Levels - You can now level-up! Earn enough experience points from playing games and you will rise through the adventurer ranks!

Leaderboards - Your XP is uploaded to a leaderboard, so you can compare your XP with everyone! A 'friends-only' leaderboard is available too. NOTE: the XP leaderboard MAY be reset when the game is released for technical reasons.

Runestones - The biggest new addition is the Runestone system. Runestones are cards you can collect as you level-up and are attached to your characters. Runestones can be equipped for online games too, when that feature is added, so level-up as much as you can before then! See the Runestone guide in the Guides section for more information, or just play the game and discover them for yourself!

Classic Rules - A new button on the game setup screen allows you to create a game based on the standard Talisman rules as per the board game. This means -
All characters are randomly drawn.
When a character is killed, they return as a random character.
Characters do not use Runestones.

The Reaper has retreated to his Inner Region space.

AI Bug fixes -
	Picking up objects improved. The AI will no longer pick everything up and then work out what to keep.
	AI players will now show more urgency to get to the Crown of Command if another player is there or nearly there.
	
Spell-casting timer increased.

Destruction can now be cast after you've moved but before you encounter the space you're on, so you can use it to destroy cards on your space.

New sound effects for Random, Immobility, Counterspell, Hex and Command spells.

3 whole seconds shaved off the loading time! More time to play!

Next update will include -
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER!

notes.title: Update #2: Dice with Death!
notes.content:
Update #2: Dice with Death!

The shadowy face of Death stalks the land! 
As a special Halloween treat, the Grim Reaper will take part in all of your Talisman games. The music has a temporarily spooky feel to it too! Please note that this is NOT the Reaper expansion pack, merely one small part of it.

See below for a brief run-down of how he will stalk you.

Fixes -

AI fixes -
	Alchemy Spell and Alchemist Follower usage improved.
	AI players will now target weaker players and avoid stronger players when moving.
	Elf will no longer move between Woods spaces so much.
	Druid would sometimes get stuck in an infinite loop of choosing cards, now fixed.
	AI being undecided about who to visit at the Village fixed.
	AI's suicidal tendencies improved.
	AI checks to see if it has a Talisman before rolling at the Warlock's Cave.
	AI will always roll to use Armour if it has some.
	
Spells - 
	Divinity - Adventure cards are now displayed in secret.
	Temporal Warp - can now be cast in the Inner Region.
	Command - is now classed as a spell and can therefore be countered.
	Immobility - usage made clearer.
	Destruction - can now be cast after moving.
	Counterspell - could be cast by Toads! Fixed.
	
Other fixes - 

	Settings button displayed - the Spanner icon on the left of the screen opens the settings screen.
	Thief is now Neutral.
	Marker to show when a character has lost all of their lives.
	Players can no longer see a Prophetess' drawn spell.
	
The Grim Reaper -

Whenever any player rolls a 1 for their movement, they have their turn as normal, but then they get to move the Reaper! They roll again to move the Reaper (double-click a space to move him), using normal movement rules, but with these exceptions -
The Reaper can move freely between the Outer and Middle Regions.
The Reaper can not move into the Inner Region.

If the Reaper lands on a space with one or more characters, the player who moved the Reaper must choose a choose a character on that space for the Reaper to visit. The player controlling that character then rolls one die and consults the chart that appears to see what happens...
1) Lose all lives.
2) Lose a random Follower, or lose 1 life if you have no Followers.
3) Dice with Death - roll 2 dice for yourself and 2 dice for the Reaper. If the Reaper's result is higher, you lose 1 life. Otherwise, there is no effect.
4) Miss your next turn.
5) The Reaper visits another character of your choice, who must then roll on this chart.
6) You may choose to gain either 1 Strength, Craft, life, gold, Spell, fate, or teleport to any other space in the same region.

The race for the Crown has never been deadlier!

Thanks again for all of the feedback so far and keep it coming!

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for the feedback so far!

We've just released an update with the following issues fixed - 

[list]
[*] The annoying audio repeating bug is fixed.
[*] AI trying to get past the Sentinel when it isn't strong enough improved.
[*] Game runs at full screen by default.
[*] Cannot browse the purchase deck when it isn't your go - this caused the player to get stuck browsing the cards.
[*] Some other minor fixes.
[/list]

Added - new victory screen!
Added - asks for confirmation before overwriting a saved game.
